pattern.description: Clicking Create swaps the side panel from the create-field form to the new Slider field's settings, while the table scrolls left to reveal a new 'competitive differentiator' column with empty slider cells and the Fields badge ticks 7 to 8.
pattern.why_premium: One click visibly lands in two places at once (settings panel and a live new column), so the viewer sees the field exist immediately; no loading state or modal break in flow.

build_hint.gsap: At the click: gsap.set(formView, {autoAlpha: 0}); gsap.set(settingsView, {autoAlpha: 1}) (or a premium gsap.from(settingsRows, {autoAlpha: 0, y: 8, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.03})); table track gsap.to(tableScroller, {x: -115, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}) while gsap.from(newColumn, {autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.2}); badge text swap 7 to 8.
build_hint.remotion: Panel view chosen by frame >= clickFrame (step); for a softer build, settings rows opacity/translateY via spring({frame: frame - clickFrame - i, fps, config: {damping: 200}}); table translateX = interpolate(frame - clickFrame, [0, 9], [0, -115], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); new column opacity interpolate over 6 frames.

notes: Screen recording; the panel swap is an instant re-render (energy spikes on single frames ~1007 and ~1010), and the table shift may be a jump rather than an eased scroll. A blue focus-ring outline lingers near the cursor at the end (inside b02), likely a rendering artefact of the clicked Create button.
